data.professional_title: VICE PRESIDENT | LEAD BUSINESS ANALYST | SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST
data.summary:
Business Analysis and transformation leader with 13+ years of experience delivering high-impact finance transformation projects across Wells Fargo, Oracle, BNP Paribas, Citibank, and Wipro. Deep expertise across Banking, Financial Services, Payments, AML, Finance Transformation, Regulatory Change, Product Delivery, and M&A Integration.
Known for translating complex business priorities into scalable execution, improving delivery governance, driving Agile transformation, and influencing senior stakeholders across India, US, APAC, EMEA, Philippines, and LATAM markets. Experienced in driving modern transformation through AI-enabled process improvement, automation, data-driven decision making to improve efficiency, control frameworks, and business outcomes.
Combines strategic thinking, operational rigor, stakeholder leadership, and future-ready execution excellence — well suited for VP Business Analyst, Lead BA, Senior BA, Product Owner, AVP, and Transformation Leadership roles.
LEADERSHIP IMPACT
Business Transformation
Led Waterfall to Agile transition (Scrum / Kanban), improving delivery velocity and governance maturity.
Delivered strategic programs across banking, finance, AML, payments, and regulatory domains.
Increased JAPAC regional contribution from 10% to 50% during Oracle integration programs.
Delivered acquisition integration initiatives with 100% timeline adherence.
Delivery Excellence
Achieved 99% requirements accuracy with minimal rework and downstream leakage.
Delivered 98% adherence to planned release commitments.
Reduced post-production defects to <1% through strong release controls.
Delivered high-volume AML reconciliation across 300+ data feeds (300M+ monthly transactions).
Leadership, Innovation & Stakeholder Impact
Led teams of 15 members across onsite/offshore operating models.
Presented Quarterly Business Reviews to leadership across India, Philippines and US.
Partnered with Product, Technology, Risk, Operations, Finance, and Business leaders globally.
Improved team capability contribution from 33% to 66% through mentoring and workload redesign.
Championed AI-assisted analysis, automation, and smarter reporting practices to improve productivity and decision speed.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Wells Fargo | Vice President – Lead Business Execution Consultant (Risk & Monitoring Transformation)
June 2021 – September 2024
Led enterprise business analysis initiatives for strategic banking transformation programs.
Owned full SDLC delivery from business requirements and process flows through use cases, validation and UAT, achieving 99% requirements accuracy and sub-1% post-production defects.
Managed roadmap priorities, sprint execution, governance controls, and stakeholder alignment.
Improved release predictability through Agile transformation, achieving 98% adherence to planned releases.
Delivered 99% requirements accuracy while reducing post-production issues to <1%.
Leveraged automation and AI-assisted workflow practices to improve reporting turnaround and governance efficiency.
Oracle | Project Manager – Finance Transformation & M&A Integration
May 2019 – May 2021
Led end-to-end finance integrations for strategic acquisitions across global business functions.
Managed Legal, Tax, Treasury, HR, Finance, and Operations workstreams.
Delivered integration programs with 100% timeline adherence and strong governance controls.
Increased JAPAC ownership contribution from 10% to 50% through operating model redesign.
Improved integration tracking through data-led reporting and streamlined controls.
BNP Paribas | Senior Business Analyst – Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB Accounting Platform)
April 2017 – April 2019
Managed accounting platform enhancements and full business analysis lifecycle delivery.
Owned BRD, FRD, impact assessments, UAT, sign-offs, and release readiness.
Improved local team contribution from 33% to 66% through optimized workload planning.
Delivered 100% financial rollover accuracy across fiscal year transitions.
Strengthened reporting accuracy through process automation and control improvements.
Wipro Technologies (Client: Citibank) | Business Analyst – AML & Payment Gateway Projects
June 2014 – March 2017
Led AML reconciliation and payments transformation initiatives across global markets.
Managed requirements across source systems, partner teams, and business owners.
Oversaw 300+ integrated data feeds supporting 300M+ monthly transactions.
Delivered 98% UAT success rate for RCX payment gateway rollout covering SEPA and SWIFT payments across ISO 20022 and MT,MX message types.
Improved operational monitoring through dashboarding and data-driven exception management.
Wipro Technologies | Software Engineer
February 2010 – July 2012
Worked on Agile delivery for insurance technology platforms.
Coordinated development and QA teams for enterprise releases.
Supported Quote & Bind application enhancements for Nationwide Insurance.
Contributed to faster sprint delivery through cross-team coordination.
